analysis.reasonEn: Maintained 'watch' stance for 3 consecutive trading days. RSI remains in neutral territory, and the MACD histogram is worsening, indicating downward pressure. Trading volume is extremely low at 0.17x the 5-day average, lacking conviction for directional moves. While the 52-week position at 34.1% is still low, the absence of clear buy/sell signals makes 'watch' the rational approach.
